create or alter procedure [dbo].[GetRenderedTemplateBodyNg] @TemplateType varchar(25), @Type varchar(50), @ID int, @Action varchar(50), @SubjectName VARCHAR (200) = 'Governing Domain', @resourceId int = -1 AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @html nvarchar(max), @link nvarchar(2500), @icon nvarchar(250), @hasDynamicFields bit = 0, @hasStats bit = 0, @typeID int, @showIcon bit = 1, @current int, @max int, @name nvarchar(250), @value nvarchar(max); declare @tbl table (ID int identity, Name nvarchar(250), Value nvarchar(max)); if @TemplateType = 'Tooltip' begin set @html = null; end declare @n nvarchar(250), @t nvarchar(250), @s nvarchar(25), @v int, @dc datetime, @du datetime, @d nvarchar(4000); select @typeID = C_D.TypeID, @icon = '
', @n = C_D.DisplayValue, @t = C_D.TypeName, @d = f.formattedvalue, @link = AUrl.Url from AssetDetail C_D cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetUrlById](C_D.ID) AUrl left join fieldtype ft on (ft.[object] = C_D.[type] and ft.objectid = C_D.typeid and ft.name = 'Description') left join field f on (f.fieldtypeid = ft.id and f.[objecttype] = C_D.[object] and f.objectid = C_D.objectid) where C_D.[Object] = @Type and C_D.ObjectID = @ID; if @n is not null begin if @link is null begin insert into @tbl values ('Name', @n) end else begin insert into @tbl values ('Name', '' + @n + '') end insert into @tbl values ('Description', @d) end insert into @tbl values ('Type', @t) if @Action = 'AssigningItemPreview' begin set @html = '

{Name}

' end if @Action = 'LookupPreview' begin set @html = '{Items}' if @Type = 'ReferenceItemType' OR @Type = 'ReferenceItem' begin declare @refs table (RowID int identity, ID int) declare @isHierarchy bit = 0; declare @MyRefTypeID int if @Type = 'ReferenceItem' begin Select @MyRefTypeID = AST.[ObjectId] from Asset A inner join AssetType AST on AST.ID = A.AssetTypeID Where A.[Object]='ReferenceItem' and A.[ObjectId]=@ID select @isHierarchy = count(1) from intersecttypedetail where [object] = 'ReferenceItemType' and [objectid] = @MyRefTypeID and predicatetype = 3 end else begin set @MyRefTypeID = @ID end if @isHierarchy = 1 begin insert into @refs select top 500 A.objectid from Asset A inner join AssetType AST on (AST.ID = A.AssetTypeID) inner join AssetDisplayValue AD on AD.AssetID =A.ID inner join [intersect] id on (id.objectid = A.objectid and id.[object] = A.[object]) inner join [intersect] id_2 on (id_2.[object] = 'ReferenceItem' and id_2.[objectid] = @id and id_2.subjectid = id.subjectid) inner join [intersecttypedetail] it on (it.id = id.intersecttypeid and it.id = id_2.intersecttypeid and it.[object]='ReferenceItemType' and it.predicatetype = 3) where AST.objectid = @MyRefTypeID and AST.[object] = 'ReferenceItemType' and A.[State] = 1 and A.ID not in (select AssetID from ResponsibilityDetail where ((PermissionsBitMask & 1) = 0) and ResourceID = @resourceId) order by DisplayValue asc end else begin insert into @refs select top 500 A.objectid from Asset A inner join AssetType AST on AST.ID = A.AssetTypeID inner join AssetDisplayValue AD on AD.AssetID =A.ID where AST.ObjectId = @MyRefTypeID and AST.[object] = 'ReferenceItemType' and A.[State] = 1 and A.ID not in (select AssetID from ResponsibilityDetail where ((PermissionsBitMask & 1) = 0) and ResourceID = @resourceId) order by DisplayValue asc end declare @refFieldTypes table (ID int identity, Name nvarchar(250)) insert into @refFieldTypes values ('Code') insert into @refFieldTypes select FriendlyName from FieldType where [Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' and ObjectID = @MyRefTypeID order by ColumnOrder asc declare @refHtml nvarchar(max) set @refHtml = '' set @refHtml = @refHtml + '' set @current = 1 select @max = max(ID) from @refFieldTypes while @current <= @max begin select @name = Name from @refFieldTypes where ID = @current set @refHtml = @refHtml + '' set @current = @current + 1 end set @refHtml = @refHtml + '' set @refHtml = @refHtml + '' select @current = min(RowID) from @refs select @max = max(RowID) from @refs while @current <= @max begin set @refHtml = @refHtml + '' declare @refFields table (Name nvarchar(250), Value nvarchar(4000)) declare @refID int select @refID = ID from @refs where RowID = @current insert into @refFields select 'Code', Code from Asset where [ObjectID] = @refID and [object]='ReferenceItem' insert into @refFields select FriendlyName, FormattedValue from FieldWithRelation where ObjectType = 'ReferenceItem' and ObjectID = @refID declare @rfCurrent int, @rfMax int, @rfCurrentVal nvarchar(max); set @rfCurrent = 1 select @rfMax = max(ID) from @refFieldTypes while @rfCurrent <= @rfMax begin select @name = Name from @refFieldTypes where ID = @rfCurrent if exists (select 1 from @refFields where Name = @name) begin select @refHtml = @refHtml + '' from @refFields where Name = @name; end else begin set @refHtml = @refHtml + ''; end set @rfCurrent = @rfCurrent + 1 end delete @refFields set @refHtml = @refHtml + '' set @current = @current + 1 end set @refHtml = @refHtml + '' set @refHtml = @refHtml + '
' + @name + '
' + coalesce(Value, '1') + ' 
' if @max >= 500 begin set @refHtml = @refHtml + '
Showing top 500 items
' end insert into @tbl values ('Items', @refHtml) end; if @Type = 'Resource' OR @Type = 'ResourceType' begin declare @resourceItemsHtml nvarchar(max) set @resourceItemsHtml = '' set @resourceItemsHtml = @resourceItemsHtml + '' set @resourceItemsHtml = @resourceItemsHtml + '' select top 10 @resourceItemsHtml = @resourceItemsHtml + '' + '' + '' + '' + '' from reporting.Global_Resource order by LastName, FirstName asc set @resourceItemsHtml = @resourceItemsHtml + '' set @resourceItemsHtml = @resourceItemsHtml + '
First NameLast NameEmail
' + FirstName + '' + LastName + '' + Email + '
' insert into @tbl values ('Items', @resourceItemsHtml) end; if @Type = 'ReferenceItem' begin declare @myReferenceListID int Select @myReferenceListID=AST.ObjectId from Asset A inner join AssetType AST on AST.ID = A.AssetTypeId Where A.[ObjectId]=@ID and A.[Object]='ReferenceItem' declare @referenceItemHtml nvarchar(max) set @referenceItemHtml = '' set @referenceItemHtml = @referenceItemHtml + '' set @referenceItemHtml = @referenceItemHtml + '' select top 10 @referenceItemHtml = @referenceItemHtml + '' + '' + '' from AssetDetail D inner join AssetType T on T.ID = D.AssetTypeID and T.[Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' and T.ObjectID = @myReferenceListID order by DisplayValue desc set @referenceItemHtml = @referenceItemHtml + '' set @referenceItemHtml = @referenceItemHtml + '
Name
' + DisplayValue + '
' insert into @tbl values ('Items', @referenceItemHtml) end; if @Type = 'ReferenceItemType' begin declare @referenceItemTypeHtml nvarchar(max) set @referenceItemTypeHtml = '' set @referenceItemTypeHtml = @referenceItemTypeHtml + '' set @referenceItemTypeHtml = @referenceItemTypeHtml + '' select top 10 @referenceItemTypeHtml = @referenceItemTypeHtml + '' + '' + '' from AssetDetail D inner join AssetType T on T.ID = D.AssetTypeID and T.[Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' and T.ObjectID = @ID order by DisplayValue desc set @referenceItemTypeHtml = @referenceItemTypeHtml + '' set @referenceItemTypeHtml = @referenceItemTypeHtml + '
Display Value
' + DisplayValue + '
' insert into @tbl values ('Items', @referenceItemTypeHtml) end; end if @Action = 'None' begin set @html = '

{Name}

' end if @Action = 'Statistics' begin set @html = '

{Name}

{Statistics}
' set @hasStats = case @Type when 'Artifact' then 1 when 'Taxonomy' then 1 else 0 end if @hasStats = 1 begin declare @statsHtml nvarchar(max) declare @stats table (ID int identity, Name nvarchar(250), Score bit) set @statsHtml = '' set @statsHtml = @statsHtml + '' set @current = 1 select @max = max(ID) from @stats while @current <= @max begin select @statsHtml = @statsHtml + '' + '' from @stats where ID = @current set @current = @current + 1 end set @statsHtml = @statsHtml + '' insert into @tbl values ('Statistics', @statsHtml) end; end if exists (select 1 from ResponsibilityDetail where ((PermissionsBitMask & 1) = 0) and resourceid = @resourceId and [object] = @Type and objectid = @ID) begin set @html = 'This item either does not exist or you do not have access to its details.'; select '' as Title, @html as Body; end else begin set @current = 1 select @max = max(ID) from @tbl while @current <= @max begin select @name = '{' + Name + '}', @value = COALESCE(Value, '') from @tbl where ID = @current if @showIcon = 1 begin if @name = '{Name}' and @icon is not null begin update @tbl set Value = '
' + @icon + '
' + '
' + @value + '
' where ID = @current end end set @html = REPLACE(@html, @name, @value) set @current = @current + 1 end set @html = '
' + @html + '
' select '' as Title, @html as Body; end end
' + Name + '' + case when Score = 1 then 'Pass' else 'Fail' end + '
